title: BUILD-SITE-090-founder-only-design-qa-cockpit
universal_lens: The design QA cockpit formalizes a constrained projection operator mapping high-dimensional, proprietary state spaces onto a bounded, user-facing manifold. This structural unification enforces strict boundary conditions to preserve epistemic asymmetry while optimizing the visual and cognitive signal-to-noise ratio for downstream decision actors.
gsi_mapping: In GSI, this cockpit acts as a conformal prediction filter. It maps raw Bayesian posterior probabilities into calibrated, risk-aware confidence intervals presented via high-contrast visual tokens. The system strictly bounds method leakage by projecting only marginal distributions that satisfy rigorous compliance constraints.
gse_mapping: For GSE, the cockpit governs situational state transitions. It translates complex, multi-agent game dynamics into discrete, actionable UI states. By isolating the runnable app from the visible workspace, it ensures deterministic rendering of tactical insights without exposing underlying simulation kernels.

primitives.name: Epistemic Boundary Projection Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Public/Private Boundary Public sees reveal-less explanations, confidence-safe language, and last-verified/source cues where appropriate.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Dimensionless projection operator; information entropy measured in bits; time-stamps in ISO 8601.
primitives.assumptions: Information asymmetry is maintained if the public projection lacks sufficient statistics to reconstruct private priors.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs when public cues form a complete basis set for reverse-engineering proprietary methodology.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to conformal inference masking layers in GSI that prevent exact probability recovery.
layer2.telemetry: Method leakage risk score (MEDIUM) and copy scan compliance rate.

primitives.name: Compliance Manifold Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Legal / Compliance Boundary No live sportsbook/casino affiliate links, no guaranteed wins, no irresponsible gambling copy, no minors targeting, no legal claims without approval.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Binary constraint indicators (0/1); regulatory penalty functions in arbitrary currency units.
primitives.assumptions: The valid output space is a convex subset of all possible UI renderings defined by hard legal limits.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Violations occur at the boundary of the manifold when generative copy models hallucinate prohibited guarantees.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to GSE's hard-stop state machines that veto illegal betting actions.
layer2.telemetry: Legal risk metric (LOW) and automated copy scan rejection rates.

primitives.name: Cognitive Signal Hierarchy Filter
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Design Direction Premium sports intelligence command center: cinematic but fast, high contrast, calm reading states, strong hierarchy, sports-native signal language, no casino/tout feel.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Contrast ratios (dimensionless); rendering latency in milliseconds; cognitive load in arbitrary attention units.
primitives.assumptions: User comprehension follows a hierarchical decay function optimized by high-contrast, low-noise visual inputs.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Visual polish without clarity leads to cognitive overload and retention failure.

layer2.mapping: Mirrors GSI's feature importance weighting, prioritizing high-signal tactical data over aesthetic noise.
layer2.telemetry: 10-second clarity metrics, engagement duration, and mobile viewport screenshot validation.

reasoning_traces.think:
The Founder-only design QA cockpit operates as a sophisticated mathematical interface between hidden, high-dimensional proprietary models and the constrained, two-dimensional reality of a web browser. We define the core problem as finding an optimal projection operator that minimizes information loss regarding actionable insights while maximizing the suppression of underlying methodological priors. This requires establishing a strict epistemic boundary, mathematically analogous to a conformal prediction filter in GSI, which ensures that the rendered UI elements—high-contrast signals, calm reading states—carry maximum semantic weight without leaking the generative kernel. The compliance manifold introduces hard constraints, effectively carving out invalid regions in the design space where 'casino/tout' aesthetics or 'guaranteed wins' would reside. By treating the visible workspace as an isolated, runnable app distinct from the source truth, we create a dualistic system: one layer handles complex, multi-agent situational reasoning (GSE), while the other manages the psychological and legal safety of the end-user. The breakdown regime emerges when the visual hierarchy fails to suppress noise, leading to cognitive overload, or when the boundary projection becomes invertible, allowing astute users to reverse-engineer the founder's edge. Thus, the cockpit is not merely a UI component but a rigorous state-transition manager that enforces anti-collinearity between business value (conversion, trust) and methodological secrecy.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This primitive traces its lineage to Shannon's information theory and the development of secure multi-party computation. Historically, financial terminals like Bloomberg pioneered the separation of raw market data from proprietary analytical overlays. In modern quantitative finance, the concept of 'black-box' algorithms necessitates interfaces that provide confidence intervals without revealing model weights. The cockpit extends this by applying conformal inference principles to frontend design, ensuring that every pixel serves as a calibrated, legally compliant signal rather than a leaky representation of internal state.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We model three primary agents: the Founder (seeking to protect IP while driving conversion), the User (seeking rapid, trustworthy tactical clarity without cognitive friction), and the Regulator (enforcing hard boundaries against predatory patterns). The cockpit anticipates the User's attempt to infer certainty from ambiguous signals, deliberately deploying 'confidence-safe language' to manage expectations. It simultaneously counters the Regulator's heuristic searches for 'guaranteed wins' by structurally eliminating such linguistic vectors. The system assumes the User is a rational actor who will disengage if the signal-to-noise ratio drops below a critical threshold, hence the emphasis on '10-second clarity' and 'strong hierarchy'.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity is enforced through a strict veto mechanism between the design layer and the backend methodology. If a proposed UI change increases visual appeal but correlates with a higher probability of method leakage (e.g., displaying exact win probabilities instead of tiered confidence), the compliance manifold triggers a rollback. This prevents the optimization of engagement metrics from inadvertently exposing the GSI/GSE core. Furthermore, the 'no casino/tout feel' directive acts as a stylistic veto, ensuring that the psychological framing remains grounded in sports intelligence rather than gambling addiction triggers, thereby maintaining the structural integrity of the trust boundary across all layers.
